principle: Structured, engineered composition with one dominant visual idea.
rules: Use one dominant visual idea per composition.
Anchor key content to a grid edge.
Prefer generous negative space over decorative filler.
Use amber as an accent, not a large default field.
Allow oversized typography to crop only when legibility remains obvious.
Keep the primary logo out of dense patterns and busy image detail.
Use diagonal crops sparingly to create movement.
Do not stack multiple brand motifs in the same area.
Maintain a clear reading order: brand/section, headline, supporting information, action/data.
Cards should align to the same grid as the page rather than creating an unrelated micro-grid.
